description: Add `deferred` to the decision status enum (alongside pending / accepted / rejected / running / completed) and a `revisit_after` ISO-date field. Prep-agent filters deferred decisions from the pending queue until `revisit_after` passes, at which point they re-surface automatically with a note indicating they were deferred. CLI: `prompt-manager team decision-defer <team-id> <id> --revisit-after=YYYY-MM-DD --notes="..."`. UI: deferred items visible in a separate tab with the revisit date; clicking surfaces the original decision unchanged. Today's workaround is to reject-with-notes, which is semantically wrong (we don't disagree; we're waiting for data) and makes the decision-history log unreliable as a signal of which proposals were rejected on merit. Surfaced 2026-04-24 vision walk when operator wanted to defer dec-1776984436121140045 (run-introspector tier-1 verification gate) for ~7 heartbeats to see whether a recent detectRateLimit fix eliminated the underlying pattern.
name: prompt-manager-decision-deferral-primitive
title: Add decision deferral primitive (deferred status + revisit_after)
